ordering: Pure text/percentage/duration/template validation and classification preview occur outside writer locks. Every accepted write then uses one short LLD-01 UnitOfWork, revalidates Customer/CPL/policy/current-classification state, inserts one command receipt before receipt-FK children, mutates owned authority, appends minimal audit/result evidence and commits.

commands.name: CreateProductLine
steps: validate bounds
inside UoW allocate id/insert receipt/Product Line active/audit/commit
rules: Customer-neutral
equal name is review hint not identity/no silent merge

commands.name: UpdateProductLine
steps: revalidate exact row
same value -> NO_CHANGE
insert receipt/update descriptive name+revision/audit/commit
commands.rule: does not modify any Contract/CPL policy or historical report label

commands.name: CreateContract
steps: validate text
inside UoW prove Customer active
allocate id/insert receipt/Contract active/audit/commit

commands.name: CreateContractProductLine
steps: validate policy outside lock when supplied
inside UoW require active Contract/Product Line
allocate CPL id
insert receipt/CPL
when policy supplied append immutable policy revision+tiers and set current pointer
audit and commit
rules: CPL without current policy cannot receive new active SR classification
template has no authority until materialized under this CPL

commands.name: ReviseSlaPolicy
steps: run POLICY_VALIDATION_V1 including percentage exactness, reduced rational duration bounds, tier ordering and exact generated Non-fault inquiry tiers
inside UoW require active CPL/Contract and unchanged current policy pointer
allocate next revision ordinal and immutable tier ids
insert receipt/revision/base tiers/derived Non-fault tiers
advance CPL current_policy_revision_id/revision
audit old/new policy revision refs and commit
rules: prior policy immutable
live SR/cohort calculations immediately use new current policy on next read regardless of Report Date/terminality
completed reports unchanged

commands.name: SetCatalogLifecycle
steps: inside UoW run dependency guards
archive fails if it would strand active CPL/current classification/policy obligations as applicable
insert receipt/update lifecycle/revision/audit/commit
rules: archived CPL is ineligible for new classification
historical classifications/reports remain readable

commands.name: CreateClassificationMapping
steps: normalize account code through governed LLD-02 key
inside UoW require active Customer, active CPL/Contract and exact Customer compatibility
insert receipt/mapping active/audit/commit
rules: does not require uniqueness; multiple active same-key mappings deliberately become ambiguous and block auto-classification
discarded Product cannot be mapping key

commands.name: SupersedeClassificationMapping
steps: inside UoW revalidate active mapping
insert receipt/set active=0/closed_command/revision/audit/commit
commands.rule: does not rewrite prior automatic classification events

commands.name: ClassifyServiceRequest
steps: inside UoW re-read SR resolved Customer/source input token, target CPL/Contract lifecycle/current policy and current classification
require exact Customer match and usable current policy
automatic requires exact unique currently active mapping still resolves to target
same current target -> semantic NO_CHANGE
insert receipt/append assign or reclassify event/update current classification
audit independently and commit
rules: does not change SR Customer/lifecycle
reclassification recalculates live projections by derivation only

commands.name: ClearSrClassification
steps: inside UoW require current classification
insert receipt/append clear event/remove current row/audit/commit

commands.name: ApplyBatchClassification
input: exact preview target list with per-target base tokens
one selected target CPL or per-target intents
steps: outside writes produce full eligible/incompatible/stale/unresolved/individual_review partitions with exact totals
for each eligible selected target call ClassifyServiceRequest as its own idempotent command/UoW and retain one result
targets that become stale/incompatible are reported individually and not coerced
return exact per-target disposition plus batch summary
rules: batch is intentionally independent-per-target rather than one huge transaction
no selected SR is silently skipped
one failure does not roll back already committed unrelated target

commands.name: InvalidateClassificationForCustomerChange
input: caller command_context referencing the already-inserted LLD-03 parent receipt; no local command_id
steps: read current classification in caller UoW
if absent return NO_CHANGE
resolve current CPL Contract customer
if compatible return NO_CHANGE
append invalidate_customer classification event/remove current row using caller receipt/context
append owner audit/result ref and return without commit
rules: never selects replacement CPL
never inserts a command receipt or commits independently
preserves prior classification evidence for later review
LLD-03 SetServiceRequestCustomer owns replay resolution, command receipt, outer UnitOfWork and final commit
